intro: Jon is a flying axe that can talk. If you think that's weird, he can also recite Rush E note for note.
TA DA! Norway! Time to get going.
Norway was where I got Jon, but also where I was killed and brought back to life.
Arrows move you. Z swings me. X throws me. I always come back. Because I'm loyal.
dive: I jumped in the lake to get away from the penguin.
Found you! Rocketing you out like the lady of the lake!
boss: The possessed, rabid, crazy penguin. He's waiting on the shore.
Dodge his charge, then chop him! Stay on the move!
revive: He killed me. (Not going into details about that.)
Voodoo magic! Now we're bonded for eternity. Get up, zombie!
I'm an undead voodoo magic zombie now. I hit harder, but I can't die twice.
win: You killed the penguin while he was shocked about the zombie thing!
Ever since, Jon has been making penguin noises in the middle of the night.
Next stop: Flight 364. Don't look at the flight attendant.
quips: You can't get rid of me.
game_over: Un-unalived once. Not twice. Press Z to try again.
